name: Husbands Role
overview: Scripture teaches that the husband's role is foundational in the marriage relationship, beginning with leaving parents and uniting with his wife as one flesh (Genesis 2:24). He is appointed as the head of the wife, analogous to Christ's headship over the church, carrying the responsibility to love sacrificially as Christ loved the church (Ephesians 5:23, 25). While wives are called to submit to their husbands as to the Lord (Ephesians 5:22), husbands are entrusted with loving leadership, not dominion, reflecting Christ's self-giving love. The husband’s role also includes faithfulness and respect for the sanctity of marriage (Matthew 5:32) and exercising authority with care, as indicated in the original order given after the fall (Genesis 3:16).
